method: per-criterion median across three judges, then weighted by the rubric

notes.problem: No creek; an opaque black plane; a brown slab floating at roof height.
notes.fix: Delete the slab; limestone ledges on both banks with the far bank lamp; the standing_water sheet at mid-door.

notes.problem: Opaque matte black plane; brown slab floating at hood height; cabin hotspots; foliage through the dek.
notes.fix: Standing-water sheet with ripple and slight transmission, a grime gradient, ledges on the far bank, no cabin speculars, the crown punched out of the dek.

notes.problem: Does not read as a flood; cropped slab on a black plane; a brown block reads as furniture.
notes.fix: A lit rippled brown surface at the beltline with broken highlights, delete the block, light a limestone bank behind.

notes.problem: The window doesn't read as a window; toy car on a bookshelf.
notes.fix: A large window with blinds behind the monitor; the car 10 m outside under its own lamp; crop the books.

notes.problem: Window reads as shelving; the car cropped and illegible; book stack clutter.
notes.fix: One square window with blinds throwing sodium stripes; the car whole and small under one lamp; cut the books.

notes.problem: The window car reads as a toy on a shelf.
notes.fix: A visible window frame with the car small and distant under its own lamp, or drop it and crop tighter.
A raked windscreen and arch cutouts in CH.carField; the camera at about 12 m.
Silhouette cues on the LOD mesh; narrower aisles; the hero at the near row.

notes.problem: Glassless loaf instances read as tiles.
notes.fix: A silhouette with a dark glass band and arches; a lower camera.

notes.problem: Flat box nose-on; wheels cut by the comal line so the car hovers.
notes.fix: Swing 15 to 20 degrees off axis; the water edge about 1 m in front of the tyres with contact on dry asphalt.

notes.problem: The car hovers on dark struts.
notes.fix: Seat the body on lit tyres with contact at the water's edge.

notes.problem: The pole crosses the dek; the rider pressed into the bumper.
notes.fix: Move the lamp about 3 m east; the rider 1.2 m off the car toward the camera.

notes.problem: Mannequin figure behind the tailgate; the pole through the dek's right edge.
notes.fix: The rider mid-stride beside the rear door; the pole moved right of the dek box.

notes.problem: Lit and unlit posts barely distinguishable; the car closer than the October row.
notes.fix: Pre-April posts near black, a stronger pool on the lit span, the car parked at the October row's depth.

notes.problem: Lit and unlit posts look the same.
notes.fix: Pool the key only over the 177 posts from the ring to the car.

notes.problem: Flat dark-blue water mirroring no lamp; olive grass band; dead band; car under half the width.
notes.fix: A mirror material streaking the lamps, near black shoulder, a longer lens so the car spans about 60 percent.
